13.01.2023 Order This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
. 2.  Heard learned counsel for the Parties.

3. The present Writ Petition has been filed with the following prayer:-
"

It is therefore prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to admit the writ application, call for the records from the learned Court below and issue notices to the opposite parties as to why a direction shall not be issued to the opposite parties to remove the fine numbers of home pipes installed in between the stithiban land of the petitioner as described under Annexure-1 series to the present writ application or pay adequate compensation with accrued interest thereon for the unauthorized acquisition of land of the petitioner with the aid of statutory provisions of Right to fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 within a stipulated period and on their failure to show cause or showing insufficient cause, this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to allow the writ application and may further be pleased to pass such otherf/further order or orders direction or directions or issue appropriate writ(s), in the facts and circumstances of the present case."
4.

sentences.text: In course of hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioner states that highlighting his grievances, the Petitioner has made a representation to Opposite Party No.4 vide Annexure-2 and the same may be directed to be considered within a stipulated time, to which learned Counsel for the Opp. Party has no objection.

without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.4 to consider the representation filed by the petitioner vide Annexure-2 and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of four weeks from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
